name: Rawapening Run Heritage 2026
short_description: Rawapening Run Heritage 2026 is a road race on Sunday 29 November 2026 from Fort Willem I in Ambarawa, Central Java, Indonesia, with 21K, 10K and 5K categories.
ai_summary: Rawapening Run Heritage 2026 is held on Sunday 29 November 2026, starting and finishing at Fort Willem I, a 19th-century Dutch fort in Ambarawa, Semarang Regency, near Lake Rawa Pening. It offers a 21K, a 10K and a 5K, each with Open and Master categories, with flag-offs at 5am, 5.30am and 5.45am. The 21K has a 3.5-hour cut-off and seven water stations, and normal entry fees run from IDR 150,000 to IDR 300,000.

faqs.question: When and where is Rawapening Run Heritage 2026?
faqs.answer: Sunday 29 November 2026. All three races start and finish at Benteng Fort Willem I in Ambarawa, Semarang Regency, about an hour south of Semarang city. The 21K flags off at 5am WIB, the 10K at 5.30am and the 5K at 5.45am.

faqs.question: What are the distances and cut-offs?
faqs.answer: A 21K with a 3.5-hour cut-off, seven water stations and about 80 m of climbing; a 10K with a 2.5-hour cut-off; and a 5K with a 2-hour cut-off. Minimum ages are 17 for the 21K, 14 for the 10K and 10 for the 5K (with a parent or guardian). 21K finishers receive a separate finisher jersey.
